## Network journey follow-up, branch combat/network-validation

Version: 0.11.0-combat.1. Continued from clean commit 6663055; main remains 35458fa. Reuses parent #10 and validation/authority issues #19, #8 and #4. No reference client files were changed or executed.

Fixed an input compatibility regression in public/game.js: paired screen-direction keys produced a world-vector component of roughly 1.414, exceeding the runtime command gate's limit of 1. Both move and directional dodge were rejected. The browser now normalizes the keyboard vector before sending intent. The actual key handlers, command gate and dodge direction are exercised for all four paired WASD directions with DOM doubles. This test failed on the prior implementation and passed after the fix; it is not a real browser observation.

New observed runtime evidence uses native WebSocket clients against unmodified spawned server.js instances. The clients send only supported gameplay intents and read broadcasts; they do not mutate a world fixture, upload saves, inject resources or use a debug endpoint:

- Two fresh characters choose Fist/Spear, navigate normal city exits, study with Dara, complete the dummy route, time a practice guard, earn their hidden unlocks and use both hidden skills. Both clients receive the earned unlocks. A consensual spar verifies guard, timed dodge and the same-attacker River-Step Counter without crime or Focus gain. Travel retains unlocks and clears transient combat; disconnect removes the player, and reconnect starts fresh. The full scenario passed in approximately 27.2 seconds.
- Four separate fresh-host scenarios cover standard and enhanced activation for both paths. Fighters earn 60 Focus for standard trials and 72 before the enhancement trials by fighting live prowlers. Enhanced trials also complete a route on the bandit. The tests verify the distinct resource costs/cooldowns, two Fist or four Spear primary hit ordinals at the scheduled simulation times, per-victim limits including live collateral, and identical event identities/results on an observing client. Repeated activation with fabricated Focus/cooldown fields is rejected. A defeat after completion legitimately resets Focus and is distinguished from another activation. These scenarios passed in approximately 22.6–33.8 seconds; these are test elapsed times, not browser FPS measurements.

Validation: installed Node v26.13.1 ran the exact package test command (`--test tests/*.test.js`): **61/61 pass**, zero failures/skips, approximately 34.1 seconds. Initial live-test assertions were corrected to distinguish legitimate area collateral from primary hits and post-ultimate defeat from duplicate resource spending; no combat rules were relaxed. The exact check command exits 0 with the unchanged missing Unity ProjectSettings and Packages/manifest.json warnings. The exact build command regenerated the standalone and dist/offline artifacts successfully; tools/verify-offline.js passed for 38 source scripts, 39 inline scripts and 46 source hashes, with guiVerified false. npm remains absent from shell PATH, so installed Node ran the package scripts directly.

Browser availability was checked again through the computer-use inventory: no browser surfaces were returned, with `The browser access host is unavailable`. No native browser input or workaround was attempted. Manual browser launch/playthrough/layout, measured rendered FPS, physical LAN latency/loss/load and buffer tuning remain unverified. Existing animation/audio adapters remain placeholders; Unity remains uncompiled. These network tests strengthen automated acceptance but do not complete the full release.
